_comment: Canonical model registry + model cards. Each entry describes WHAT a model config is, so the leaderboard is self-documenting. `id` is stable (runs reference it — names can't collide). Edit here, then `npm run db:init` to sync. Card fields: kind (combo|single), components (the actual models in the config), base (finetune base, if any), tasks (which of the 4 it targets), released, notes.

models.name: Qwen+Gemini
models.notes: Qwen does OCR, Gemini does reasoning/extraction.

models.name: Chandra-only
models.notes: CPT base; LoRA adapters fine-tuned on top. The in-house track.
